facts.fact: Lunar 叼来一朵粉花，Amrita 一碰到就被回忆击中（樱花、跳舞、他的手）。
facts.anchor: As soon as the pink flower hit her palm, she was slammed by memories

facts.fact: Amrita 说即使能理解 Jamie 为何不告诉她，这件事对她仍太危险。
facts.anchor: It’s too dangerous. You saw how badly the magic hurt me.

facts.fact: Jamie 对 Mia 说 Amrita 没回电话，认为她态度已很清楚。
Rayenne 道歉并说当时没有别的选择，否则她会受更重的伤。
facts.anchor: there wasn’t another choice that would have protected you from worse

facts.fact: Amrita 回想 Hudsbury 之前的生活虽然烦但简单，她以为可以回去。
Rayenne 说她的魔法一直引导她走向这份职业。
facts.anchor: Your magic has been your guide

facts.fact: Rayenne 说她的魔法是「阈限型」，像导乐一样陪人度过人生转折。
facts.anchor: threshold magic – a little like a doula

facts.fact: Rayenne 说她可以选择从此不进 Hudsbury，一辈子不受魔法打扰。
facts.anchor: You could ignore it and never enter Hudsbury again

facts.fact: Amrita 决定帮忙，因为不帮的难受远大于害怕。
facts.anchor: Being scared was far less bad than how bad she would feel if she didn’t help.

facts.fact: Lunar 说她们有让 Mia 与 Aiden 不必取消婚礼的计划，但需要 Amrita 帮忙。
